full_judgment: 2. It has been stated in the Writ Petition that Government acquired 1.17 acres of land from plot No. 327 under CS Khatian No. 123, belonging to Abul Hossain for making Mohakhali- Tejgaon link road in LA Case No. 66/57-58. The land was recorded in SA and RS Khatian in the name of the Government. Out of the said acquired land, 0.73 acres of land was unutilised. The heirs of Abul Hossain filed an application to the Ministry of Communication for derequisition of the said land and by order dated 26-2-1984 the Ministry of Communication de-requisitioned 0.73 acres of land. On 9-10-1985 the said land was given in possession of Abul Hossain. Noor Hossain, son of late Abul Hossain, transferred 0.035 acres of land to Mofizul Islam by sale deed dated 8-2-1986 and gifted 0.05 acres of land in favour of his wife, Karimunnessa. The heirs of Abul Hossain transferred 0.2997 acres of land in favour of Alef Mia, the predecessor of the petitioners by deed dated 19-2-1987. Alef Miah mutated his name and paid rents to the Government. The said purchased land was demarcated by a sketch map. The petitioners filled up 10 feet deep approaching road to the main road and approached the authority for leasing out the said land and it has been stated that a verbal assurance was given to them for leasing out of the said land. On 27-3-2003 respondent No. 6 filed an application for leasing out 0.32 acres of land from plot No. 327 for establishing a CNG filling station. On 1-4-2003 respondent No. 5 leased out the said land to respondent No. 6. The petitioners challenged this order on the ground that if this land be delivered to respondent No. 6 this would encroach their purchased land and this being violatative of fundamental right granted to a citizen for maintaining property under the Constitution, obtained this Rule.
